posts.author: Alibaba_Qwen
posts.text: Qwen-Image-2.1 supports up to 10 reference images and can produce high-quality results. https://t.co/TuTvzEGhy8

posts.author: Alibaba_Qwen
posts.text: Qwen-Image-2.1 supports a variety of editing tasks while balancing performance across them. For example, given a three-view character reference, the model generates a complete storyboard. https://t.co/CKELeRLyhH

posts.author: Alibaba_Qwen
